integrity: The proof uses only the published atomic-value restriction, the published negation multioperation, and the published support condition. An exact replay independently generates and prunes all rows through depth 13 and checks the recurrence through depth 200.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the pure iterated-negation family in the Leme--Coniglio--Lopes Nmatrix and does not classify formulas involving implication or binary connectives.
The constant final-table size does not imply constant cost for an implementation that explicitly materializes the Fibonacci-many initial rows.
The exact profile is a specialization of the published semantics and deletion rule rather than a new completeness theorem.
title: Fibonacci-to-four collapse for iterated negation in intuitionistic non-deterministic truth-tables
